# Task 5: Bank Account Simulation
## Objective Simulate basic bank operations using Java OOP with class-based design and transaction tracking.
## Deliverables - `Account.java`: encapsulates account data, `deposit`, `withdraw`, balance handling, and transaction history. - `BankAccountSimulation.java`: menu-driven CLI runner to perform transactions.
## Features - Create an account with account number, holder name, and initial balance. - Deposit and withdraw money with validation. - Prevent invalid amounts and overdraft withdrawals. - View current account balance. - View full transaction history with timestamps.
## Tech Used - Java - VS Code / Terminal
## How to Run From project root (`D:\ElevateLabs-Java-Internship`):
```powershell javac -d out src\Task5\*.java java -cp out Task5.BankAccountSimulation ```
